title: Useful lives of tangible assets (Companies Act, Schedule II)
description: The useful lives, in years, that Part C of Schedule II to the Companies Act, 2013 gives tangible assets, for financial years from 2026-27: each entry in the Schedule's words with the headings printed above it, its useful life for single-shift working, and whether extra-shift depreciation is permitted under paragraph 6 of the Notes after Part C. An entry is NESD (no extra shift depreciation permitted) when the mark is printed on it or on a heading above it, and an entry whose life is printed as ditto (-do-) has the life of the entry above it. Continuous process plant, item IV(i)(b), is not included: its life from 1 April 2014 was set by Notification G.S.R. 237(E) of 31 March 2014, whose Gazette copy has not been found.

instruments: Companies Act, 2013 (18 of 2013), Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 1, No. 27, 30 August 2013: Schedule II, Part C and Notes, paragraph 6, in force 1 April 2014, read with section 123(2)

Notification G.S.R. 1075(E), 17 November 2016, Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Note: Schedule II came into force on 1 April 2014 and was amended by G.S.R. 237(E), 31 March 2014, with effect from 1 April 2014, and by G.S.R. 627(E), 29 August 2014
